TD Studios: Next.js 15.5.4/TypeScript luxury site, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Resend, OpenAI ChatKit; pnpm 10.15.1. v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. **Primary Development**: Use v0.app interface for major changes. **Manual Edits**: Consider sync implications when making direct code changes. **CI Pipeline**: Use `pnpm ci:verify` for comprehensive validation before commits.

Environment: create `.env.local` from `.env.local.example`: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

Commands:
`pnpm dev`
`pnpm serve`
`pnpm build`
`pnpm lint`
`pnpm typecheck`
`pnpm ci:verify`
`pnpm report:types`
`pnpm scan:secrets`
`pnpm scan:secrets:staged`
`pnpm test`
`pnpm test:watch`
`pnpm test:jest`
`npx playwright test`
`npx playwright test --ui`
`npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts`
`pnpm lh:routes`

**Pre-commit hook**: Scans staged files for secrets before commit
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
**Pre-push hook**: Enforces feature branch workflow and runs comprehensive secret scan
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }
**Branch Protection**: Feature branch workflow enforced - all changes to main must go through PRs.

Routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. API: `api/contact/` (Resend), `api/chatkit/session/` (OpenAI), `api/intake/` (Supabase). JWT client authentication uses `jose`.

Key paths: `app/globals.css`, `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`, `components/`, `components/ui/`, `lib/analytics.ts`, `lib/ab-testing.ts`, `tests/`, `tests/setup.ts`, `tests/screenshots/`, `vitest.config.ts`, `ROUTES.md`, `docs/architecture-map.json`. Vitest unit tests; Playwright mobile E2E. `@/*` maps to project root. Use accessible, responsive, mobile-first components, design tokens, analytics tracking and strict typing.
